g.text: The estimator needs every cell of a pair's grid non-empty,

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26282b

g.text: so it reports a reason rather than a number.

g.text: This slot stays empty on purpose. Drawing a zero here would

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26282b

g.text: say the model has no intersectional effect. What it says is

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26282b

g.text: that this instrument cannot express one.
